title: Cinder
tagline: You are one ember, and you are going out.
description: You fall through a burning canopy with only as much life as you have heat, and heat is spent just by existing. Everything green you touch catches and gives some back; catch several in a row and it gives back more. The rain does not care. Steer with momentum, read the wind, and see how far down you get before the light goes out.
author: HexCave
controls: Arrow keys or A / D to steer
howToPlay: You are an ember falling through a burning canopy. Steer with the arrow keys or A and D — you carry momentum, so start turning early.
Your heat drains constantly, and when it hits zero you go out. The bar along the bottom is your life.
Touching anything green sets it alight: that scores points and gives some heat back. Twigs are worth more than leaves.
Catch several in a row without missing and the multiplier climbs, up to six times.
Water costs you a third of your heat. Wind bands push you sideways whether you like it or not.
Press space to flare: it widens your reach for half a second at the cost of some heat.
goal: Fall as far as you can before your heat runs out. Points and distance both count towards your best.
